L209: Description
L210: ### General description
L211: 
L212: Due to the unstable, hygroscopic nature of the free acid, the calcium salt is employed.
L213: 
L214: Vitamin B5 or pantothenic acid is a viscous oil that is soluble in ethanol and water. It is produced by plants and microorganisms. d-(+)pantothenic acid is the naturally occurring form of pantothenic acid and is biologically active.
L215: ### Application
L216: 
L217: Precursor in the biosynthesis of coenzyme A.
L218: 
L219: Calcium pantothenate has been used:
L220: 
L221:   * as a component of vitamin solution for synthetic media
L222:   * as a component of vitamin mix for the ICS medium mix
L223:   * as a component of a chemically defined diet for metal depletion studies in Drosophila
L224:   * as a supplement to study coenzyme A metabolism in mouse models of non-alcoholic steatohepatitis
L225: ### Biochem/physiol Actions
L226: 
L227: The calcium salts of panthenol are commonly used for pharmaceutical preparations. Pantothenate is a component of coenzyme A and is useful in its synthesis. Pantothenic acid is also involved in the synthesis of heme, cholesterol and fatty acids. Since vitamin B5 is found in all foods, its deficiency is not commonly observed.
